title: 101 W. Commerce St.

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located in the heart of Downtown San Antonio. The property sits on the northwest corner of W. Commerce and N. Main Avenue.

rows.label: Size
rows.text: Approximately 7,863 square foot two story building with additional basement space of approximately 1,248 square feet on .077 +/- acres of land

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility, and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The Federal Emergency Management Agency maps do not indicate any floodplain on the site.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: This property would suit a variety of commercial uses including restaurant, bar, office, mixed use, and other commercial uses.

comments: The property is one block from the San Antonio River Walk, across the street from Main Plaza and the San Fernando Cathedral.
The property is also one block away from the new apartment project called, “300 Main.”
